puzzles.hint: Nothing defends the rook on a4. Which piece can reach it?
puzzles.success: Bxa4+ wins a free rook, because nothing guarded it.

puzzles.hint: One rook already guards the 7th rank. Use the other on the 8th.
puzzles.success: Rg8 is mate. The two rooks cover both ranks.

puzzles.hint: Knights jump in an L. Count the squares from d3.
puzzles.success: Nxf4. Always check what your knights can reach.

puzzles.hint: White's king is trapped behind its own pawns.
puzzles.success: Rb1 is a back-rank mate.

puzzles.hint: Pawns capture one square diagonally forward.
puzzles.success: exd4. Even a pawn can win a knight.

puzzles.hint: Your king covers the 7th rank. The queen can finish from far away.
puzzles.success: Checkmate. The queen and king work together.

levels.title: Double Attacks
levels.summary: Forks, and mates on the back rank.

puzzles.hint: Find a knight jump that checks the king and hits a8.
puzzles.success: Nc7+ forks the king and the rook.

puzzles.hint: From d6, a knight attacks e8 and b7.
puzzles.success: Nd6+ forks the king and the queen.

puzzles.hint: A pawn on c4 attacks b5 and d5.
puzzles.success: c4 forks the knights. One of them falls.

puzzles.hint: Put the queen next to the king where your king protects her.
puzzles.success: Qg7 is mate. The king on f6 guards the queen.

puzzles.hint: White never made room for the king. Look at the first rank.
puzzles.success: Checkmate on the back rank.

puzzles.hint: One diagonal runs to h8 and another runs to a1. Where do they meet?
puzzles.success: Bd4+ checks the king and attacks the rook.

puzzles.hint: The king and the queen stand on the same long diagonal.
puzzles.success: Bg2+ skewers the king. When it moves, the queen falls.

puzzles.hint: The knight on e6 cannot move. It is pinned to the king.
puzzles.success: d5 attacks the pinned knight, and it cannot run.

puzzles.hint: Black's own pieces box the king in. Only a knight can reach it.
puzzles.success: Nf7 is smothered mate.

puzzles.hint: The knight on f6 guards g8.
puzzles.success: Rg8 is mate. The knight protects the rook.

puzzles.prompt: Win the queen for a rook.
puzzles.hint: Line your rook up with the queen and the king behind it.
puzzles.success: Re1 pins the queen to the king. She can only trade herself for the rook.

puzzles.hint: The king on h1 has no room. Check it along the first rank.
puzzles.success: Checkmate. The pawns trap their own king.

puzzles.hint: A knight on c2 attacks e1 and a3.
puzzles.success: Nc2+ forks the king and the queen.

puzzles.prompt: Black weakened the king. Checkmate in one.
puzzles.hint: The diagonal from h5 to e8 is wide open.
puzzles.success: Qh5 is mate. Moving the f- and g-pawns early opened the king.

puzzles.hint: If the bishop moves, the rook gives check. Move it where it attacks the queen.
puzzles.success: A discovered check. Black must answer the rook, and the bishop takes the queen.

puzzles.hint: Your king takes away c7, d7, and e7.
puzzles.success: Rh8 is mate. King and rook make the classic edge mate.

puzzles.hint: Check the king from a square that also sees a8.
puzzles.success: Check first, then the rook falls.

puzzles.hint: White opened the diagonal from h4 to e1.
puzzles.success: Qh4 is Fool's Mate, the fastest checkmate there is.
